description: The line plot, titled “BBQ,” illustrates the accuracy (y-axis) of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations (x-axis), with higher accuracy indicating better performance. The x-axis, labeled “#Demonstrations,” ranges from 0 to 1500 with major tick marks at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 45 to 55 with tick marks at intervals of 5. Four models are compared: “Squared Exponential” (solid dark blue line with circular markers) starts at approximately 52.5 at 0 demonstrations, rises to about 55.5 by 250 demonstrations, and remains nearly flat thereafter. “Truth” (solid medium blue line with circular markers) begins near 49, slightly increases to ~49.5 by 250, and then stabilizes. “ELU” (solid light blue line with circular markers) starts at ~48.5, increases marginally to ~49 by 250, and plateaus. “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” (dashed pink line with circular markers) remains constant at approximately 46.5 across all demonstration counts. The plot demonstrates that performance for the first three models improves slightly or stabilizes after 250 demonstrations, while LLaMA-2-chat-7B shows no improvement with additional demonstrations.
